summary: Termwise, 𝔯·lowColumns(σ) ≤ a/p/m + [σ ∈ tops]·a/x₁ for even σ (not thick, so w(σ) = a/x₁; 𝔯 = 1 when m ≤ p and then σ is a top); the δ_p term is small against f(log b)²a/(pm).

steps.claim: Bound the sum termwise by a/p/m + [σ ∈ tops]·a/x₁ (shown below), and use loss ≥ f(log b)²a/p, #Λ ≤ f and the definition of δ_p.
steps.lean:
grw [cast_sum, mul_sum, sum_le_sum (g := fun σ ↦ D.a / p / D.m + ite (σ ∈ D.tops)
    (D.a / D.x₁) 0) fun σ a ↦ ?_, ← le_loss, H.card_le, deltaP]

steps.claim: The δ_p part: f·𝔯·f·(n_m + 𝔯) plus f·a/p/m is ≤ f(log b)²a/(pm) (size).
For σ ∈ evenPlaces(Λ): lowColumns ≤ w(σ) + x^60, and σ is not thick (`notMem_thick`), so w(σ) = a/x₁.
steps.lean:
simp at a; grw [(lowColumns_lowBoxes_bounds hj σ).2.1, nominalWeight,
    ite_eq_right (H.notMem_thick σ (.inl a))]

steps.claim: p is served (Λ nonempty); cases p ≤ m or m ≤ p.
steps.lean: obtain ⟨⟨_, _, _, e⟩, c | c⟩ := H.2 ⟨_, a⟩, le_total p D.m

steps.claim: If p ≤ m: 𝔯·(a/x₁ + x^60) ≤ a/p/m (size: p·m ≤ m² ≤ 4x and 𝔯 ≤ log x₁).
If m ≤ p: 𝔯 = 1 (`clog_eq_one`), and σ is a top (o₀ = 1 since o₀ ≤ 𝔯; σ is induced like a top), so the term a/x₁ is available: a/x₁ + x^60 ≤ a/p/m + a/x₁ (size).
steps.lean:
rw [ceilLogM, clog_eq_one D.nat_le_of_hasLogBound c] at *; grw [ite_eq_left (by
    grind [inducedPlace_eq_or_star_iff, H.3, tops, one_pow, o₀, orderOf_eq_one_iff]),
    add_comm]; simpa using D.le_of_hasLogBound
